sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 1m
facts: Approximately 99% England coverage at 1 m resolution
Bare-earth terrain is produced by removing surface objects
Newest best-resolution repeat surveys are used and resampling uses bilinear interpolation
EPSG:27700, Newlyn-referenced heights, WCS access and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
sources.limit: Survey dates vary spatially and the published RMSE is not a parcel-specific confidence interval

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 2m
facts: Approximately 99% England coverage at 2 m resolution
Bare-earth terrain semantics match the 1 m DTM
EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
WCS access is exposed
sources.limit: The 2 m layer is a sensitivity check and cannot replace the pinned 1 m metric

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
facts: Official 10 m composite DTM is available
It remains a bare-earth terrain product
EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm source-survey RMSE are documented
The full national ZIP is supplied
sources.limit: Ten-metre resolution is too coarse for primary sub-metre parcel measurement

sources.name: LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: Time-stamped terrain archive extends through 18 April 2024
EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
OSGM02-to-OSGM15 adjustment grid is supplied
Survey date and datum lineage remain material
sources.limit: Historical surveys cannot be mixed without explicit date, transformation and geoid checks

sources.name: LIDAR DSM Time Stamped Tiles
facts: DSM contains terrain plus buildings, vegetation and other surface objects
The dataset uses the OS Grid and British height-datum family
Survey metadata records date, resolution, transformation and geoidal model
Published vertical accuracy is ±15 cm RMSE
sources.limit: DSM values must not replace the bare-earth DTM parcel height-difference metric

sources.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model (DSM) 2m
facts: Official composite DSM service is available at 2 m resolution
EPSG:27700 and ±15 cm RMSE are documented
WCS, WMS and WMTS service contracts are exposed
The product is related to the 2 m DTM
sources.limit: Surface-model values are a negative control only and cannot be promoted as terrain

sources.name: INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset
facts: Contains indicative locations of registered freehold property in England and Wales
Files are divided by local authority
Each polygon has a unique Land Registry INSPIRE ID
Boundary polygons can appear in both neighbouring authority files
sources.limit: INSPIRE polygons are indicative and are not legal title plans

sources.name: INSPIRE current monthly download
facts: Current package was published 5 July 2026
Files are published on the first Sunday of each month
Downloads are organised by local authority
Download use is subject to Open Government Licence conditions
sources.limit: Freshness must be revalidated after the next monthly publication

sources.name: Technical guidance for GML files
facts: Source polygons are captured against British National Grid
Native CRS is EPSG:27700
Web-map display requires reprojection
BNG-to-WGS84 conversion may shift some features by up to 15 m
sources.limit: Exact containment and raster sampling must remain in native British National Grid

sources.name: Use Land and Property Data catalogue
facts: INSPIRE Index Polygons are free of charge
Licence type is Open Government Licence
Update cadence is monthly
GML is the published format and no API is listed
sources.limit: Catalogue metadata does not prove the bytes of a specific local-authority package

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 documentation
facts: Open height dataset for Great Britain
Updated annually in July
Grid uses regular 50 m post spacing
Data is supplied in 10 km by 10 km National Grid tiles
sources.limit: Landscape-scale resolution cannot validate a sub-metre parcel span

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 overview
facts: Lower-resolution digital terrain model
Buildings and trees are removed from the ground surface
Intended for landscape visualisation and analysis
Published grid accuracy is 4 m RMSE
sources.limit: Four-metre RMSE supports gross-outlier screening only

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 technical specification
facts: Grid and contour forms share source data
Both forms are supplied in 10 km tiles
Grid formats include ASCII and GML 3.2.1
Compressed folders contain data and supporting files
sources.limit: Specification text does not prove integrity of a particular downloaded archive

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 grid data specification
facts: ASCII tiles contain 200 rows by 200 columns
Each pixel is 50 m by 50 m
Height values are calculated from pixel centres
Heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1 m
sources.limit: Current archive headers and raster bytes still require direct verification

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 metadata specification
facts: Per-tile XML metadata follows GEMINI conventions
Metadata identifies product and spatial representation
The 10 km tile reference is recorded
Metadata is supplied for national products and per-tile delivery
sources.limit: Metadata cannot replace hashes of the archive and raster payload

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 source data
facts: Source terrain is represented as a triangulated irregular network
Mass points and breaklines retain significant terrain features
Grid and contours are interpolated from the source TIN
The product is generalised for small-scale use
sources.limit: Interpolation and generalisation reinforce the coarse crosscheck-only role

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 product supply
facts: Online download is available without registration
The tiled national set contains 2,858 ten-kilometre tiles
Tiles are arranged in 55 one-hundred-kilometre folders
Annual full-tile resupply occurs in July
sources.limit: Availability does not prove that the required TQ archive bytes were obtained in this runtime

sources.name: OS Terrain 50 GML feature types
facts: GML geometries express CRS as urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::27700
Height values reference Newlyn or another applicable British height datum
Feature and geometry identifiers are unique within a release
Identifiers can be regenerated after a whole-tile refresh
sources.limit: Release-specific identifiers are not stable evidence across refreshed tiles

sources.name: EPSG 27700 registry definition
facts: Identifier resolves to OSGB36 / British National Grid
Registry classifies it as a projected CRS
The authority code is 27700
Use includes topographic mapping and engineering survey
sources.limit: A CRS identifier does not prove that a dataset was correctly transformed or sampled

sources.name: Web Coverage Service standard
facts: WCS Core defines mandatory implementation requirements
WCS 2.0.1 remains an official core standard
CRS, scaling, range subsetting and interpolation are separate extensions
Coverage access must be assessed against implemented conformance classes
sources.limit: Standards text does not prove that a specific endpoint returned correct parcel values

sources.name: WCS 2.0.1 executable compliance test suite
facts: Suite checks GetCapabilities and DescribeCoverage access
GetCoverage KVP behaviour is tested
Mandatory requirements and XML schemas are validated
Core, scaling, interpolation and range-subsetting classes are covered
sources.limit: The generic suite is not evidence that the Environment Agency endpoint was certified by it

sources.name: WCS interpolation extension notice
facts: Interpolation affects subsetting, scaling and CRS transformation
The extension addresses positions affected by accuracy or rounding
Interpolation behaviour is a separate service concern
Explicit control is necessary when processing coverages
sources.limit: A standards-development notice does not establish the interpolation method used by a specific response

checks.name: SAFE_SYNC_NO_HARD_RESET
checks.detail: Snapshot before sync, include-untracked stash when dirty, atomic fetch and ff-only merge; hard reset forbidden.

checks.name: SINGLE_RUNNER_FAIL_CLOSED
checks.detail: Multiple or ambiguous canonical processes block startup; no second daemon is created.

checks.name: REV16_BLOB_AND_IDENTITY_PIN
checks.detail: Task, attempt, branch, revision16 runtime blobs and exact target rows are pinned.

checks.name: METRIC_GUARD_BEFORE_TERRAIN_AND_WEB
checks.detail: EA DTM1m max-minus-min consistency must pass before Terrain50 and port8012.

checks.name: CURRENT_CANDIDATE_BINDING
checks.detail: Exact row, HMLR, height_difference_m and confidence bindings remain fail-closed.

checks.name: NO_UNSUPPORTED_PROMOTION
checks.detail: Static checks do not promote current business rows or final_ready.
